text: Northwind Regional will open a new hub at Castellane Airfield on March 3, the airline and local officials said Tuesday, marking the carrier’s first major base in the eastern coast corridor. The company plans to station four turboprop aircraft at the field and add nonstop service to seven cities by early summer, including Veyport, Lorian and Saltmere. Castellane’s airport authority said the move is expected to create 86 jobs in ground operations, maintenance and customer service. “This is a major vote of confidence in Castellane’s future,” said airport director Eliane Voss. Northwind said introductory fares will go on sale next week, with daily service beginning the day the hub opens.
